1  HON'BLE ABDUL SHAHID, J. 
1. Heard learned counsel for the revisionists and the learned A.G.A. for the State.

2. The instant revision has been preferred against the impugned order dated 04.12.2024 passed by Additional District and Sessions Judge/Special Judge (POCSO Act), Siddharth Nagar in Special Session Trial (POCSO) Case No.714 of 2024 (State Vs. Kapil Bhati), arising out of Case Crime No.30 of 2024, under Sections 363, 366, 376 I.P.C., and 5/6 POCSO Act, Police Station Trilokpur, District Siddharth Nagar.

sentences.text: 3. An FIR under Section 363 I.P.C. had been lodged by the complainant/father of minor victim.
After investigation, the charge sheet was filed only against Kapil and not against any other persons.
Thereafter, the prosecution has filed an application under Section 319 Cr.P.C. for the summoning of other co-accused.
4. The revisionist no.1-Zuber Ahmad and revisionist no.2- Shahzad were summoned on the application under Section 319 Cr.P.C.

After framing of the charges the statement of the minor victim had been recorded as PW-1, wherein, she specifically stated in her examination-in-chief vide order dated 30.09.2024 that Zuber Ahmad and Shahzad had committed rape with her consequently.
PW-1/victim further stateed in her cross-examination-in-chief i had left her house on the call of Shayra.
She confined himself in her house and threatened if she stated any further then i will kill you, at that time, Zuber Ahmad and Shahjad were also present.
Thereafter, both the persons took her alongwith Bolero Marshal vehicle and they had delivered minor to Rajesh after taking the packets of Rs. 500 notes.
Thereafter, Rajesh took myself to Maharajganj and delivered to myself Radhey Shyam.
Radhey Shayam forcefully performed my marriage with Kapil Bhati and Kapil Bhati had maintained physical relationship with myself for 3- 4 months and i became pregnant of 2 months.

As per law laid down by Five Judges Bench judgment of Supreme Court in Hardeep Singh Vs. State of Punjab and Others, (2014) 3 SCC 92, for summoning of an accused under Section 319 Cr.P.C. the evidence has to be more than prima facie case, whichever is required for framing the charges.

entities.text: Hardeep Singh Vs. State of Punjab and Others, (2014) 3 SCC 92
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The statement of minor/victim in her examination-in-chief is very much specific against both the revisionists Zuber Ahmaad and Shahjad and the allegations are very serious and heinous nature.
In view thereof, the said statement further corroborated by the statement of PW-2 who is the father of victim.
5. In view of the above, neither there is any illegality nor any irregularity in the impugned order dated 04.12.2024 and the revision is liable to be dismissed.
6. It is accordingly dismissed.

(Abdul Shahid,J.) November 7, 2025 Imtiyaz  Zuber Ahmad And Another vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 7 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/177128497/
